narrationTexts: I'll search the codebase for remaining `db.query` calls.
finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All 12 pass `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | 2 calls. File says do not edit. Upgrades wipe local changes. |
| `cache.query` in repo files | Different API. Not part of this move. |

No tests in the repo, so I could not run any.

Next: raise the vendor `legacy-orm` calls with the driver upgrade, since `query` dies in the next major.
